statement: Guinand-Weil explicit-formula quadratic form Q_{jk}=arch+pole-prime, restricted to the 4-dim basis phi_a(x)=exp(-x^2/2)cos(a x) for a in {15,25,35,45}, is positive definite.
method: Arb (flint prec=300) rigorous enclosure of each transcendental entry (arch=rigorous integral of analytic integrand, pole=closed form, prime=finite sum+bounded tail); ||R||_F<=rho=3.45e-24 rigorous; exact-rational LDL^T on (M-rho*I) with all pivots positive rationals; Sylvester leading minors all positive (independent exact cross-check).
scope: HANDLE for this finite form on this basis. RH-CONSISTENT evidence + certificate shape. NOT a proof of RH (transcendental full form; this is a 4-dim restriction with clear margin, nearly-diagonal basis).
